SCHEDULED POWER INTERRUPTION: OCTOBER 4, 2026
Ginapahibalo sang Negros Power ang mga konsumidores nga may ara sang natalana nga power interruption sa  October 4, 2026 (Sunday).
Ini kabahin sang 5-year rehabilitation kag modernization plan sang Negros Power agud malikawan ang mga wala ginalauman kag mas lapnagon nga power interruptions kag mangin reliable ang distribution system sang aton elektrisidad.
Yari ang mga detalye sang scheduled power interruption:
Date: October 4, 2026 (Sunday)
Reason: 
● Reconductoring of 1.5km 3-phase primary line to #336.4 ACSR Tree Wire from Palanca Road to Iglesia Filipina Brgy. 9 near Locsin St., from Burgos St. To BFP;
● Replacement of poles along San Juan St. and removal of 4-span 3-phase primary line.
Time & Affected Areas:
6:00AM to 8:00AM
Portion of BF2 - Corazon Locsin Montelibano Memorial Regional Hospital, YLAC (Caltex – C.L. Montelibano), Dr. J Villarosa St., Narra  St. (Lopez Jaena St. –
Hervias & Lopez Jaena St. before Negros  Navigation Bldg.), Malaspina St. (Lopez-Jaena St. – North Drive),  North Drive (Malaspina St. – Narra Avenue), Narra Avenue (from 6th  St. Narra to Narra-BS Aquino Intersection), Yakal St., Malaspina St.  (Hilado St. to WNC), Tindalo St, Hilado St. (Burgos-Malaspina). Brgy. 18, Brgy. 19, Portion of Brgy. 20, Portion of Brgy. 21, Portion of Brgy. 22, Portion of Brgy. 23, Portion of Brgy. 24, Portion of Brgy. 26, Burgos St. (from Lacson – Bacolod Cemetery), 6th to 11th St. Lacson, Portion of Burgos Public Market, Circle Inn, WNC Gym, St. Joseph High School, West Negros/STI, Bacolod City Health Office, M-3 Dialysis Center Inc.
Portion of AGF1 - Mabini St. (Gonzaga-Malalosan St.)(Malalosan-Hernaez St.), Gonzaga St. (Mabini-Lacson St.)(Lacson-Gatuslao St.), Lacson St. (Gonzaga-Bacolod Business Inn), Rizal St. (Lacson-San  Juan St.), Cuadra St.,  Gatuslao St. (Galo-Luzuriaga St.) to Luzuriaga-Araneta, Centrolplex, Bacolod Central Market, BACIWA, San Sebastian Dawis, Bishop’s Palace, Bay Center, San Sebastian  Cathedral, DYAF – Radyo Veritas, GE Money Bank, Bacolod Business Inn, LCCB , Gaisano Grand Central (new).
Portion of AGF3 - Lacson St. (Galo-4th St.)
Portion of RF1 - San Juan St. (BS Aquino-San Juan Banago Bridge),Tilapia,Cagaycay,Ceresa,Sigay, Lison, Bolinao, Makawiwili, Shell Depot, Portion of Brgy. Banago, Sta. Clara Phase II, Prk. Langis,  San Mateo Village, Petron Depot, Prk. Paraiso, Prk. Kasagingan, Prk. Lawayan, Prk. Rosas Pandan. 888
6:00AM to 8:00AM & 5:00PM to 6:00PM
Portion of RF1 - San Juan St. (St Capitol Rd.-BS Aquino Dr.),Narra-Baybay, Lampirong, Jalandon, Tambi, Balinday, Tahong, 
6:00AM to 6:00PM
Portion of RF1 - Portion of Brgy 16, Puroks (Malipayon, Boulevard, Mapinalanggaon, Kasing-kasing, Magti-ayon), Palanca St. (Rodriguez Ave-Burgos Ave), Bacolod Baywalk, San Juan St. (Burgos Ave-St  Capitol Rd), Puroks (Kabuhi),BFP Bacolod Fire Station.
